point_decomposition.index: signed-Frobenius orbit representative pair and relative shift; both S3 x roots keyed by minimum normal-cycle rotation
point_decomposition.target_query: one target-seeded global Frobenius orientation per indexed state; all indexed states in frozen order until a verified relation or cap
point_decomposition.root_kernel: Montgomery batch inversion across up to 4096 independent S3 equations in index and target phases; one inversion and 3(k-1) charged field multiplications for k nonzero denominators
point_decomposition.batch_policy: consecutive indexed states in frozen order; target-dependent preparation of a complete block is charged even when a hit occurs early in the block
point_decomposition.root_table: open-addressing separate u128 key and u64 value arrays; first root-key witness retained
point_decomposition.verification: try both signed curve lifts for each of four x values; re-add all four subgroup points; independent checked-Sage replay
point_decomposition.operation_accounting: separate setup, index, and target counts including batch-inversion multiplications, inversions, extra prepared target states, failures, and native relation checks; no common operation-equivalent calibration
